title: Release record
description: The record of what reached users, written by `hitld release make` when the owner makes a release (design part 3.2, Milestones and releases; HITLD-752): one file per release of a package, work/releases/<package>/<version>.md. A record directly under work/releases/, named by its v-tag, is a repository-wide record from before release packages, which `hitld release migrate` moves into the package named main. The body holds the notes. In the files backend each interface_delta entry is one line of text, "<impact> <surface>: <what>", and each depends entry "<package>@<version>"; this schema covers the entity as the read API returns it.

id.description: The tag, from the package's tag template, such as core@1.2.0, core/v1.2.0 or v0.1.0-rc.1.

package.description: The release package, one declared in policy.json release.packages. Absent only on a record from before release packages.

version.description: A semantic version. A pre-release version carries a hyphen and identifiers, such as 0.4.0-rc.1.

previous.description: The last full release of the same package before this one, which the interface delta and the bump are measured from. Absent for the package's first release. A pre-release is never the base of a bump.

bump.description: From the interface delta alone: major for a breaking change (minor while the version is 0.y.z, with a breaking entry in the delta), minor for an additive change, patch otherwise.

interface_delta.description: The changes to the public interface since previous that justify the bump (design part 16.5): for a package with a surface file, its lines added (additive) and removed (breaking), under surface.

depends.description: The exact versions of the packages this release was built against: one for each package its depends_on names, the version that package was released at or is released at in the same train.

decision.description: The decision or the precedent under which it was made: a tracker ID, a precedent ID, or owner when the owner made it directly in the main session.

train.description: The release train item this release was made under, with the other packages' releases it needs, in one owner approval.

items.description: Items closed since previous, written into the record when it is made so readers need no git.

milestones.description: Milestones whose check had passed on the released code, written into the record when it is made.
